claims.statement: Two independent gates run in order: ACCESS (Tailscale reachability — 403 without a tailscale-user-login matching OWNER_LOGIN) and IDENTITY (IdP session — 307-redirects an unauthenticated visitor into login); identity is never derived from the access gate.

The access gate is fail-closed by default with exactly one switch, APP_DEV_SKIP_ACCESS_GATE=1 (a dev-stack flag, never a deployed env value, deliberately not NODE_ENV); the identity gate runs in every environment including localhost.

The middleware matcher excludes _next/static, _next/image and favicon.ico, so decideGate never runs on those paths — the favicon entry in gate.ts's PUBLIC_EXACT is dead for the proxy while live for the unit test.
Public paths are /auth/* prefixes plus a small PUBLIC_EXACT asset set; everything else requires both gates to pass.

The IdP registers an app client (code + PKCE, secret required in production with no placeholder fallback) and one public PKCE client per producer, with redirect URIs from OIDC_PRODUCER_<NAME>_REDIRECT_URIS that production must supply or boot fails.
clientCredentials is disabled in the IdP, so no service can impersonate a user — the reason the outbox's live delivery leg is the BFF's drain.
The compose-boot CI job asserts the gate answers directly: 403 header-less on /, 307 with matching owner headers, 200 on /icon.svg (a public path that passes both gates).
